items.summary: Financial recommendation: proceed only with the already-scoped page-local SEO change; decline the generic CTA business proposal. Revenue support is insufficient for ROI or contribution-margin claims: Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21, shows $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable, and site-attributed income is $0. The target page has 77 impressions, 0 clicks, 0 sessions, and 0 conversions. AI spend is $940.70 fleet-wide for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-25, while infrastructure and fixed operating costs are unavailable; contribution margin, payback, and cost-to-learn beyond recorded AI spend are therefore not calculable. Minimum measurement: retain page-level impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, AI cost, and attributable infrastructure cost through the 14-day or 100-impression window. Do not claim revenue, ROI, incrementality, or causal lift.
